messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Peaks Diagram
parts:
If you strip out the interactivity and pile all of the peaks on top of each other it could be done using geom_area().  http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/geom_area.html

If you had all of the data in long format, you would simply put x as date/year and y as number of mentions and then color by story/disease.

The data you linked appeared to only be for SARS so it's hard to use it as an example. If you were to go at it, one thing I remember about stacked plots is that every timepoint needs a value for each story/disease. If you skip a year it breaks, so mark it zero. 

/Walter Sobchak

-Brandon
